application_limits: The new virial theorem below assumes spherical stationary tracers and full, consistently tracer-weighted second moments with vanishing pressure boundary terms.
Table 2 contains elliptical profile scales and fitted Gaussian widths of a selected sample, not certified whole-tracer virial moments.
Using these widths and scales as virial inputs is an explicitly conditional spherical reinterpretation, not a completed resolved-kinematics analysis.
A common geometry factor multiplies all radii and all derived masses; differing population shapes or selection weights require a new calculation.
Published errors are used only for finite sensitivity cases, not as independent Gaussian posterior samples.
